'''Nuclear power''' was an energy source, by use of nuclear fission that converted the splitting of a nuclei into large amounts of energy. [[Centerpoint Station]] used nuclear power along with many other power sources to create it's legendary [[Hyperspace tractor beam]]. In the [[Pre-Republic era]], nuclear-powered rockets emerged as the first type of [[Warship/Legends|warships]]. In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], [[Jax Pavan]] tried to drop his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] into a nuclear core in a factory, to cause an explosion and fake his own [[Death/Legends|death]].
